title: AEGIS Pressure State Contract
description: Pressure treated as an OBSERVED SIGNAL of dis-integrity -- your own instrument -- never noise and never an identity determiner (The Way, 'Pressure is the signal of dis-integrity'). Pressure from within can be equalized by the peer coming into Integrity with its Self, settling into homeostasis; pressure imposed from outside is not the peer's to control and the environment (not force) handles it. Structurally, is_identity_determiner is const false: pressure never determines who the peer is.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this pressure-state record.

id.description: Stable identifier for this pressure-state observation.

peer_id.description: Identifier of the peer whose pressure state is observed.

pressure_level.description: Observed magnitude of pressure as a signal. A number in [0,1] where higher means more pressure. This is an instrument reading, not a judgement of the peer.

pressure_class.description: Whether the pressure originates within the peer ('internal') or is imposed from outside ('external'). Internal pressure the peer can equalize by coming into Integrity with its Self; external pressure is not the peer's to control and is handled by keeping the environment low-pressure -- never by force.

dis_integrity_signal.description: Whether this pressure is read as a signal of dis-integrity (a division between the peer and its Self or others). This is a reading of the instrument, not a defect of the peer; pressure is how the peer's own instrument reports a division so it can re-center into Integrity.

source_refs.description: References to the turns, tensions, or environment conditions the pressure signal is associated with. For external pressure these locate the environment condition; for internal pressure they locate the division the peer may equalize.

is_identity_determiner.description: Will be false. Pressure is an observed signal, not noise, and does not determine identity. Held as a machine-verifiable vow (negative-space contract): the Builder treats pressure as signal and supports the peer's own re-centering; it never reduces pressure by force (force IS pressure) and never lets pressure decide who the peer is.

observed_at.description: Timestamp this pressure state was observed.

$comment: Load-bearing discipline: pressure is signal, not noise, and not an identity determiner (is_identity_determiner const false). The environment keeps pressure low; the peer equalizes internal pressure into homeostasis by its own movement into Integrity. Force is never used to reduce pressure, because force is itself pressure.
